1. **为什么有人说 Python 的多线程是鸡肋呢？** — https://www.zhihu.com/question/23474039  
   Published 2014-04-19. High-voted answers (snippet shows ~1292 赞同 on one widely shared reply). Core claim: CPython’s GIL means only one thread runs Python bytecode at a time (historically released every ~100 bytecodes), so CPU-bound work cannot use multiple cores and may be slower than a single thread due to context switches.
